To update itself, Heavenfall must be allowed to install apps. Android opens its settings: turn on the switch for Heavenfall, come back and tap the button again.

Heavenfall reads your game from the phone\'s storage, so Android must let it see all files. It changes nothing there.
Choose the folder where your game files are, or will be. Heavenfall reads them from there and saves the game\'s code in the same folder.
Heavenfall is made from your own copy of the American Monster Hunter 4 Ultimate, as a .3ds, .cci or .cxi file.
It also needs the game\'s 1.3.0 update, as a .cia file, from the same American game.
Optional: with your own copy of Monster Hunter XX in the same folder, Heavenfall adds gear looks and rare materials from it. You can skip this.
Copy the file into the game folder with a USB cable or a file manager, then tap Check again.
A decrypted copy is one that any program can read. Make it from your own game on your 3DS with GodMode9: an encrypted copy cannot be used.
